{"reason": "Widen the alert-planner branch to medium+ risk and threshold 5→6. Example rows at inventory 2.8 and 5.3 days show suggest-alternative stockouts (cost 195000; alt-lead 7>5.3); alert-planner is cheaper (35000<45000) and always on time, so stockouts fall and cost cannot rise.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
